biotools.summary: MHCquant2 is a Nextflow-based pipeline for identifying and quantifying HLA-presented peptides from immunopeptidomics mass spectrometry data. It leverages OpenMS tools and peptide property predictors to improve peptide identifications and facilitate tumor antigen discovery.
